Johar !
Every journey has a story, and every story has the power to inspire.
In the second episode of The Green Mic, we bring you a special conversation with Stefy Patel, an actor, model, and former Miss India whose journey reflects determination, ambition, and the courage to dream big.
From personal experiences to fresh perspectives, join us for an engaging conversation on journeys, aspirations, culture, travel, and the stories that inspire us. This episode celebrates the spirit of Jharkhand and the possibilities that lie beyond every horizon.
Watch Episode 02 of The Green Mic now.
